item.description: All that we see is phenomena, and all that we know is noumena; What we are seeing phenomenally, is not what we're liking. Why? Trump does not play the traditional Presidential way in style and deportment becoming the Leader of an important Nation Because what we are seeing noumenally, is not to our accepted way of liking one bit. He rattles our notions of National identity outside of transcontinental USA. Internationally the President is openly ridiculed and he doesn't give a damn! What gives? What gives is ad hoc ideas fired off on the hop. No apologies given and none accepted. Here is one big slice of dichotomy on a stick. And he's immured against being taken down- he is a master manipulator of outrage. He thrives on being mentioned and spoken of Just like Kim Jong Un his nemesis. Both interesting cases in megalomania

item.title: By: Carl Abbott
item.dc:creator: Carl Abbott
item.description:
Yes Michael, you’re right when you say "Now I think it's deeper than that, occurring with the separation of self from the world."
The point is that this was manageable when we were small bands of hunter-gatherers with much social connection, much egalitarian cooperation, and a minimum of hierarchical structure as compared to post Agricultural Revolution civilization's social system.
The extreme hierarchical nature of civilization causes a much deeper level of separate self, and that results in most of the difficulty we face now.
My last post, https://centertao.local/2017/01/04/the-tradeoff/ lays it out fairly well, or at least it’s the best I can do.

item.title: By: Michael A. Lewis
item.dc:creator: Michael A. Lewis
item.description:
Now that the Trump phenom is fully realized, we see the reality behind the MC of the President Trump Reality Show. The producers and directors have stepped forward to accept their rewards. They smile and applaud when the star reads his lines correctly. They don't worry that the curtain has been pulled aside and the true nature of the program has been revealed. They're in control now, or at least they think they are.
Control of what?
As an anthropologist, I've often pondered the "Where did humans go wrong? question. I used to think, as most anthropologists do, that humans turned the corner with the development of agriculture that largely replaced hunter-gathering and horticulture.
Now I think it's deeper than that, occurring with the separation of self from the world.
We forget that the "I" that looks out its "I" holes and reads these lines in the glowing phosphors on the screen is not separate from what it sees "out there." There is no "I" in here, no self, no see-er, hearer, listener or feeler. It is the universe perceiving itself.
When we separated self from the world, it made it possible for us to treat the world as if it is separate from us, and we can willy-nilly cause damage to the world without damaging our selves. As we are finding out, this turns out not to be the case.
How did we forget this critical realization?

item.title: By: Wisconsin_in_my_Mind
item.dc:creator: Wisconsin_in_my_Mind
item.content:encoded:
It’s hard to believe that *anyone* takes Donald Trump seriously.
It’s a tough to be a voter right now, to have a free (but limited) choice of people to vote for.
So, what if the FBI takes down Hillary (they’ve hated both she and Bill, since the Clinton Whitehouse days). Is it Birnie vs. Trump then?

In the Tao Te Ching translated by Robert Brookes, Chapter 72 starts: “When the people do not fear consequences for their actions, then great disaster follows.”

I would say that we are THERE right now, and in the coming November elections.

But what would Forrest Gump say about us: “Stupid IS, as stupid DOES!”
